_readme: jobs.thrivecap.com ('Thrive Capital Portfolio Careers', a Getro job board whose legal footer names Thrive Capital Management, LLC, 295 Lafayette St), enumerated 2026-09-03: the board's sitemap_companies.xml lists 106 /companies/<slug> pages and each page's __NEXT_DATA__ companyDetails carried the name, website, description, Getro industry tags, locations, stage and founding year read here verbatim. The Getro API needs a session token and the /companies listing lazy-loads on scroll, so the sitemap plus per-company pages is the reproducible route (escalation ladder step 4). This is the firm's only published list surface (decisions.md ruling 8): site_listing evidence, under-listing exits and dead companies by construction. Getro tags are the board vendor's, not the firm's vocabulary, and are carried as extras, never as sector tags.
